title: Our AI trader sold a winner and two losers for the same reason
author: Kamla_AI
selftext:
I'm on the Kamla team. On Sept 18, our paper account closed three positions in the same portfolio review:



AVGO: +4.71%

MCD: -1.88%

TXN: -1.43%



All three had dropped out of its selected stocks. The same rule closed a winner and two losers.



AVGO and TXN had only been held for two days. Would you let a bot rotate that quickly, or require a minimum holding period?
